name: Popover
summary: Floating content panel with arrow, title/content anatomy, open state, trigger relationship, escape dismissal, and focus behavior requirements.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Floating panel that owns surface, border, shadow, and visibility motion.

anatomy.name: arrow
anatomy.description: Optional arrow pointing toward the trigger.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible state controlled by the popover--open modifier.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The popover is hidden by default and becomes visible when popover--open is applied.

behavior.name: triggerRelationship
behavior.description: The trigger should expose its expanded state and reference the popover panel.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The popover should close on Escape, outside interaction, or repeated trigger activation.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Non-modal popovers should preserve natural tab order and restore focus to the trigger when closed by keyboard.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the popover panel is visible; trigger state, dismissal, focus restoration, and positioning remain target behavior.

accessibility: Use popover for supplemental content; use modal dialog patterns when interaction behind the panel must be blocked.
Connect the trigger and panel with aria-controls and keep aria-expanded synchronized.
Close on Escape and outside interaction.
Do not trap focus in a non-modal popover.
Use a dialog pattern if the popover contains a complex form or long interaction.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css; positioning and interaction behavior must be provided by the consuming target.
